name: Moonlight
description: Stream games from your PC with native-resolution support. Rebuilt Apostrophe wrapper with the bundled spruce moonlight-embedded engine; pair, manage servers, and launch streams from a native NextUI interface.
author: 4fuu (wrapper originally by richieszemeredi)

changelog.v0.3.1: HOME is stable again: the app yields overlay hosting by default, so NextUI's system panel handles HOME/HUD while sleep inhibit, battery/status and the SDK event channel stay active. In-process hosting is opt-in (MOONLIGHT_INPROCESS_OVERLAY=1) with step-by-step logs and a 2 s open watchdog; the overlay state report no longer blocks the UI thread and the SDK event wakes an idle widget loop.
changelog.v0.3.0: Cooperation layer: in-process full-fidelity HOME panel, dynamic overlay ownership (menu app / streaming system fallback), volume/brightness HUD, sleep inhibit while streaming, SDK battery/status rows.
changelog.v0.2.0: Self-contained fork: Apostrophe host seam, bundled spruce 2.7.0 engine and libs, C3 session launch, controlled stream spawn for the cooperation SDK, and the vendored full-fidelity NextUI overlay renderer.
